title: the shared link checker skips hosts only home can reach
why: Orchestrator, Oct 28 14:10 CDT: degen#290 (c127) is blocked on two things, it is a draft and degen's main is red on its link check; the shared link checker fails on links to hosts that only home can reach.
note: Slug readme-links-home-hosts (orchestrator, lane PR #785, batch 13). The shared link checker (actions/readme-links: links, alive, main) skips hosts only the home network can reach, so a link to one no longer turns a repo's check red; it names each skipped host in its output, so a skip is never silent. Red first: a fixture README with a home-only link, red on main today and green on the branch, and a dead public link still fails. Unblocks degen#290 (c127). Port: yes, every repo that runs readme-links. Needs no answer. Placed after c185 (triage 12, Oct 28). Merged in batch 13, PR #787 (main 60216ac9), Oct 28 16:22 CDT (lane PR #785). Done. Follow-up: degen#291 (one-line links re-pin) is item 60, reopened Oct 28 17:55 CDT: shiv marked it done, but it is still a draft on GitHub. It is still the right pin (degen main pins 95ada63d); its lane merges main in, then shiv presses Ready for review, then the coordinator merges under his one-act grant.
